name: Artorias
biography: Artorias is the creator of CicadaSolvers.com, co-host of the CicadaCast podcast, and moderator of r/cicada and the CicadaSolvers discord. Well-versed in the complex history of the Cicada 3301 puzzles, he labors both to document the mystery of Cicada 3301, and to unravel the labyrinth of its interconnected topics.
